StandState.description:
One version of a stand's safety and operating state (ADR 0075). Append-only: a change writes
the next version, and the highest version of a stand is the one in force.

couplings.description: The coupling matrix (ADR 0049): for the channel an axis steps, the volts per volt each other channel moves with it. The row of an axis's channel is what the Sweep widget puts in SweepAxis.couplings. No channel couples to itself; empty means no couplings.
couplings.title: Couplings

held.description: The held operating point (ADR 0053): the DC levels the stand server applies and every sweep inherits on channels it does not touch, at most one per channel and each within its channel's limit. After a restart it is offered, and applied only once a person confirms it.
held.title: Held

limits.description: Per-channel limits, at most one per channel. A channel without one is not limited by the stand state (its instrument's own range still applies).
limits.title: Limits

SweepAxis.description: One swept coordinate: `num` evenly spaced values of a logical channel from `start` to `stop`.

couplings.description: A virtual gate (ADR 0049): other LevelSource channels moved with this axis, by these volts per volt of the axis value, from their held level (SweepDefinition.levels) or 0. Only a stepped axis couples; a stage axis expresses its couplings in the pulse sequence (Affine).
couplings.title: Couplings

name.description: Axis name; the Dataset dimension and coordinate are named after it.

start.description: Value at index 0, in the channel's quantity unit.
start.title: Start

stepping.description: A preference for how a stepped axis advances (ADR 0064, 0066); the compiler decides and records the result in ExecutionPlan.pacing. 'auto' (the default): triggered when the stand wires the axis's instruments to the stage's sequencer and the sweep allows it, otherwise stepped by the executor. 'software': the executor sets each level and settles. 'triggered': required, so a stand without the wiring is a compile error; the axis then is the innermost stepped axis of a sweep with a sequenced stage and nothing sensed or captured per point, and at most one axis is triggered. A stage axis is swept by the sequencer and takes 'auto' only.
stepping.title: Stepping

SweepAxis.title: SweepAxis

SweepDefinition.description: An experiment as data: axes outer to inner, what is sensed, what a sequencer runs, how often.

captured.description: Time-resolved records captured at every stepped point by WaveformSense channels, after the stage and the sensed levels; each becomes a data variable with its own time axis.
captured.title: Captured

levels.description: Operating point: DC levels set once before the scan and held throughout, on channels the sweep does not step. Pulses on a gate's pulse line add to its level here.
levels.title: Levels

repeats.description: Outermost loop, run by the executor: repeat the whole scan this many times (None = until stopped). Adds a 'repeat' dimension when not 1; never averaged by the executor (ADR 0018).
repeats.title: Repeats
